violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §744.2105)
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined a caregiver used inappropriate discipline with children in care by hitting two children on the arm and shoulder and grabbing a third child by the back of the neck.

finding_variants.text: It was determined a caregiver used inappropriate discipline with children in care by hitting two children on the arm and shoulder and grabbing a third child by the back of the neck.

Based on the information provided during the course of the investigation, one staff used inappropriate discipline when the caregiver yanked a child's arm while picking the child up from the floor. The caregiver then proceeded to place the child over their shoulder to carry them.

During the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver engaged in harsh and unusual discipline with the children. The caregiver instructed the children to run lines and made them stand against the wall while holding books as punishment.
A caregiver was overheard telling a child that they would call their parent as a way of correcting the child's behavior.

During the course of the investigation, information obtained indicated that caregivers at the operation use a disciplinary practice in which all children are required to sit down, place their heads down, and have the classroom lights turned off when one child is misbehaving.
This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver pushed a child as a form of punishment.

It was determined that a staff was yelling and pulled a child by their arm to get them to clean up toys they thrown on the floor. When another child attempted to enter the center the staff pushed the child in the chest area causing them to stumble back.    The staff was immediately terminated.
